title: Library Directory
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: LIBRARY DIRECTORY
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical audio variants; runtime untested
versions.startupSource:
10 ' LIBRARY DIRECTIORY
20 FORLV=0TO10
100 READ A$
105 IF A$="DONE"THEN500
110 IF A$="D"THEN L=L+1:GOTO 100:ELSEIFA$="U"THEN L=L-1:GOTO100
120 IF L=LVTHENPRINTA$
200 GOTO100
500 PRINT:L=0:RESTORE:NEXTLV
1000 DATA"FICTION",D,SOFTBOUND,D,A-CLEVELAND(1.8),COCTEAU-HAILEY(1.7),HAMILTON-KYLE(1.6),LAGERKVIST-RUBIN(1.5),RUSSIAN-WEST(1.4)
1010 DATA"U",HARDBOUND,D,ADAMS-MICHENER(1.3),MORGEN-YERBY(1.2)
1020 DATA"U","U",NON-FICTION,D,SCIENCE,D,PHYSICAL,D,PHYSICS(4.1.R),CHEMISTRY(4.1.L),U,NATURAL(4.2),GENERAL(4.1.L),MATHMATICS(4.3.R)
